idea: SaludApp Empresas: white-label medication management platform for Peruvian employers
selected_gap: Integrated medication management system tailored to Peru

friedman_scores.note: Founder background not provided; assumed healthcare/pharma experience in Peru but unconfirmed.
Peru has ~30M population, high chronic disease burden, and growing employer health spending; TAM in Peru likely $100M+ but below $1B.
Chronic patients juggle multiple tools; pain is real but not life-threatening, so willingness to pay may be moderate.
No direct local competitor combining OCR, reminders, and risk scores; global apps lack localization; insurers may enter.
No evidence of founder's personal stake beyond idea; motivation unclear.
Smartphone penetration, WhatsApp ubiquity, and OCR advances make this timely.
Similar models exist in other countries (e.g., HealthPrize) but not in Peru; indirect proof.
B2B healthcare requires long cycles; assumed commitment but not demonstrated.
B2B SaaS can scale across employers, but sales cycle is long and pharmacy integration is country-specific.
Healthcare IT for emerging markets is underfunded; data moat is plausible.

yc_rule_scores.criterion: Do not wait for the perfect idea
yc_rule_scores.note: Validated by identifying a concrete gap and starting with customer discovery.
Presumed focus on this idea; no evidence of side projects.
Integration with pharmacy receipts, WhatsApp, and employer dashboards shows workflow understanding.

yc_rule_scores.criterion: Build at the edge of AI
yc_rule_scores.note: Uses OCR and risk scoring, but not cutting-edge AI; moat comes from data, not model.
Sells adherence improvement and cost savings; dashboard shows ROI for employers.
Combines multiple features (OCR, reminders, pricing, risk) but is focused on one market.
Customer discovery with 20–30 patients is a good start, but no mention of iterative learning.
Healthcare is low-trust; employers need reliable data; expertise is key.
Product is the platform itself; internal processes like OCR curation are not highlighted.
Early customer discovery is promising, but no pre-sales or LOIs mentioned.
B2B subscription likely per employee; could move to outcome-based pricing later.
OCR processing has variable costs; ideal to optimize but not detailed.

yc_rule_scores.criterion: Do not bolt AI onto legacy
yc_rule_scores.note: Building new platform, not augmenting legacy systems; good.

yc_rule_scores.criterion: Cover domain, model, and operations fluency
yc_rule_scores.note: Needs both healthcare domain and tech operations; assumed team has mix.

vc_rubric_scores.rationale: No founder details; assume relevant background but unproven in this exact space.
TAM in Peru <$1B but growing with chronic disease prevalence; timing is good.
Data moat from pharmacy ecosystem integration is defensible; OCR and risk scores are solid features.
No evidence of users, revenue, or pilot; only customer discovery planned.
SaaS to employers likely works; LTV:CAC TBD; margins could be good if OCR costs managed.
No direct local competitor but risk from global apps or local insurers; moat is medium.
No financial data; burn rate unknown; likely pre-seed with limited runway.
Main failure mode: execution complexity and slow employer sales cycles.

vc_verdict.reason: Weighted score 5.78 below threshold; weak: traction

decision: Proceed with further validation, focusing on employer pilots and OCR fine-tuning.
next_experiments: Conduct 20-30 in-depth interviews with HR managers of mid-sized Peruvian firms to confirm willingness to pay.
Build a minimal OCR prototype with 500 local pharmacy receipts to test accuracy.
Launch a landing page with waitlist for employers to gauge interest.
kill_criteria: Less than 10 employer sign-ups for pilot within 3 months.
OCR accuracy below 80% after dedicated tuning effort.
HR managers indicate preference for existing manual processes over any digital tool.
_iteration_one_liner: We help Peruvian employers reduce healthcare costs by boosting employee medication adherence through a localized app with OCR, WhatsApp nudges, and crowdsourced pharmacy pricing, all in one platform.
